root.command: SELECT nr.CityID, ct.CityName, nr.PreperationDate, nr.DeliveryDate, nr.NextPreperationDate, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DaysUntilDelivery, IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now(), 'PAST', 'FUTURE') AS Status FROM NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr INNER JOIN CityTbl AS ct ON nr.CityID = ct.CityID ORDER BY nr.NextDeliveryDate

SELECT ct.CityName, nr.NextDeliveryDate, COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS AffectedCustomers, DateDiff("d", Now(), nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DaysUntilDelivery FROM (NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr INNER JOIN CityTbl AS ct ON nr.CityID = ct.CityID) LEFT JOIN CustomersTbl AS c ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE c.enabled = True GROUP BY ct.CityName, nr.NextDeliveryDate ORDER BY nr.NextDeliveryDate
SELECT 'Expected Delivery Window' AS Description, DateAdd("d", 14, Now()) AS Start2Weeks, DateAdd("d", 21, Now()) AS End3Weeks

SELECT nr.CityID, ct.CityName, nr.NextDeliveryDate AS CurrentNextDelivery, DateDiff("d", Now(), nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DaysFromNow, 'NEEDS UPDATE TO FUTURE DATE (2-3 weeks ahead)' AS Recommendation FROM NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr INNER JOIN CityTbl AS ct ON nr.CityID = ct.CityID WHERE nr.NextDeliveryDate < DateAdd("d", 14, Now()) ORDER BY ct.CityName
